beats.summary: Nellie and Kevin question Andy's decision to quit his stable job to pursue acting, doubting his chances of success.

evidence.snippet: Nellie: Well, we just had a quick question about this decision of yours. You know, to leave a stable job and pursue a career in the entertainment business.
Kevin: Well, Andy, your plan sucks, okay? Nobody is going to hire you ever.

beats.summary: Oscar comments that Andy can't succeed as an actor or office employee, so he might as well go all in on acting.

evidence.snippet: Oscar: No, I don't think that he can make it as an actor. But, he also can't make it as an employee in an office, so why not go nuts with it?

beats.summary: Jim and Pam interact about office supplies and their plans, with hints of a double date involving Erin and Pete.

evidence.snippet: Jim: Hey, are you still in charge of office supplies?
Erin: Actually, maybe we should go on a double date some time. That'd be fun.

beats.summary: David Wallace offers Andy to stay on as a salesman and announces Dwight as the new Scranton branch manager.

evidence.snippet: David Wallace: You can stay on as a salesman, Andy.

beats.summary: Dwight reacts emotionally to being named permanent manager of the Scranton branch.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: I'm sorry. I've just waited for this moment my entire life.

beats.summary: Andy changes his mind and decides to stay in sales instead of pursuing acting.

evidence.snippet: Andy: Hey, everybody, I changed my mind. Not leaving. I'm gonna stay on in sales.
Nellie: Oh, thank god. Because sales could be your best role yet.

notable_quotes.quote: Andy: I'm gonna make it. Every person that has been on Conan has a crazy story about how they made it. Every person.
notable_quotes.speaker: Andy

evidence.snippet: Andy: I'm gonna make it. Every person that has been on Conan has a crazy story about how they made it. Every person.

notable_quotes.quote: Erin: Bluntly? Yes. Huge mistake. Andy, honestly, I think you might become homeless. Or maybe even starve.
